game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: petercolemonts
quote:
GTA 6 was one of the most promising games ever announced. After such a long development cycle, you would expect an absolute masterpiece. Unfortunately, the reality is a major disappointment.

The game feels way too politically driven, and one of my biggest issues is the sheer number of micro-simulation elements. Instead of delivering the GTA experience we know and love, it often feels more like a life simulator than an actual GTA game.

And that's not even mentioning the numerous basic bugs and disappointing frame rates.

Honestly, it's a huge letdown. I also find the 99 Metacritic score extremely hard to believe. Something clearly doesn't add up. This game simply does not deserve a 99.

I understand the disappointed from many gamers.
